referenceCaveat: Frozen pre-output AI partial references, not human-certified truth; 3 selected same-original crops, no independent camera views.

synthetic.name: same-unit adjacent equal-looking overlapping rectangles stay distinct
cross-unit identical physical box produces one editable object
complementary value and zero survive; unknown never erases
equal-support genuine conflict remains flagged without losing object or other values
focused AI can revise a wrong AI value, not a manual value or manual unknown
group refinement does not sum aggregate quantity or infer a residual
partial crop keeps aggregate claim non-additive; never claims unseen remainder is zero
manual aggregate remains unchanged without adding its detail again
one visible child is a partial refinement, never group quantity plus one
unregistered changed-source view never becomes same-board identity
missing source box is local uncertainty and does not block another crop object
same-unit contenders and cross-unit transitive chains never merge identities
empty response and absent source do not erase unrelated valid objects
explicit user unknown is detected by last emitted value despite null basis
free text disagreement is preserved as an alternative, not automatic string rewrite

limits: No model rerun or real HTTP/database/UI save/reopen.
Editable records validate, but source boxes are not calibrated game-board coordinates.
Focused-source precedence is a hypothesis; crops add no new pixels and can worsen attributes.
Frozen reference string equality is not semantic normalization; no reference corrections.
Three hand-picked failed cases cannot establish generalization or full-photo precision.
